metadata.projectTitle: SkillMatch — Student Skill-Based Internship Matching & Recruitment System
metadata.targetAudience: University Examination Board, Academic Evaluators, Technical Defense Committee
metadata.presentationPurpose: Academic Project Presentation, SRS Defense & Final System Demonstration

footer.leftText: SkillMatch Career Platform — Academic Presentation & Defense

layouts.name: Cover / Title Slide
layouts.purpose: Primary presentation opening slide with project identity, team, supervisor, and course meta

layouts.name: Agenda / Table of Contents
layouts.purpose: Overview of presentation flow across 6 core segments

layouts.name: Project Introduction
layouts.purpose: Contextual introduction of early-career CSE recruitment challenges and SkillMatch value prop
layouts.cardLayout: Split layout: Executive summary left, 3 core pillars right

layouts.name: Problem Statement
layouts.purpose: High-impact visual breakdown of existing industry bottlenecks (ATS filtering, resume inflation, skill gap)
layouts.cardLayout: 3 comparative problem cards with coral accents

layouts.name: Project Objectives
layouts.purpose: Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound project goals
layouts.cardLayout: 4 objective cards with numerical badges and target outcomes

layouts.name: Background and Motivation
layouts.purpose: Industry trends, engineering market shifts, and motivational rationale
layouts.cardLayout: Two-panel comparative split (Traditional Pipeline vs. SkillMatch Paradigm)

layouts.name: Literature Review / Related Work
layouts.purpose: Comparative academic evaluation of related platforms (LinkedIn, Handshake, HackerRank, LeetCode)

layouts.name: Methodology / Working Procedure
layouts.purpose: Scientific methodology and 4-phase agile engineering lifecycle

layouts.name: System Architecture
layouts.purpose: High-level multi-tier client-server architectural block diagram
layouts.cardLayout: 4 architectural tiers: Client UI, API/Auth Gateway, Service Layer, Storage Layer

layouts.name: Process Flowchart
layouts.purpose: End-to-end algorithmic flow of candidate onboarding, AST parsing, scoring, and matching
layouts.cardLayout: Sequential process pipeline with decision branches

layouts.name: Database Schema / ER Diagram
layouts.purpose: Relational entity schema detailing Chen notation entities, primary/foreign keys, and Prisma mappings
layouts.cardLayout: 6 structured entity schema cards (Users, CandidateProfile, Skills, JobPostings, Applications, Sessions)

layouts.name: Features and Functionalities
layouts.purpose: Detailed catalogue of functional requirements across Candidate and Recruiter portals
layouts.cardLayout: Two-column feature taxonomy (Candidate Suite vs Recruiter Suite)

layouts.name: Technical Implementation
layouts.purpose: Core tech stack specifications and modern frameworks utilized
layouts.cardLayout: 6 technology bento cards (Next.js 16, TypeScript 5, Prisma ORM, NextAuth v5, Tailwind v4, Supabase PostgreSQL)

layouts.name: Results and Live Screenshots
layouts.purpose: Demonstration of live production UI, landing page, and dashboards
layouts.cardLayout: Multi-frame UI showcase with live URLs and verification metrics

layouts.name: Evaluation / Testing
layouts.purpose: Experimental evaluation, performance benchmarks, and test coverage
layouts.cardLayout: 4 quantitative metric cards with tabular stats

layouts.name: Advantages and Limitations
layouts.purpose: Objective academic self-critique balancing engineering strengths against current constraints
layouts.cardLayout: Two-column balanced comparison (Key Strengths vs Current Limitations)

layouts.name: Conclusion
layouts.purpose: Synthesis of academic project outcomes, engineering achievements, and thesis validation
layouts.cardLayout: 3 conclusion highlight cards and core takeaway

layouts.name: Future Work
layouts.purpose: Roadmap for future research, LLM code review integration, and scaling

layouts.name: References
layouts.purpose: Academic IEEE-format citations of literature, software standards, and data sources
